title: pumllint requirement-traceability report
description: The output of `pumllint trace <paths> -f json`: the coverage matrix between a requirements inventory and the diagrams that reference them, both directions plus unknown references. This shape is a public contract; changes are deliberate and release-noted (drift-guarded by tests/test_schema.py). Requirement `id` values are stable identifiers: future matrix columns (process step, component, contract, verification) will arrive as additive optional properties on the requirement row, never by reshaping v1.

requirements.description: One row per inventory ID, in inventory order.

unknownReferences.description: IDs referenced by diagrams but absent from the inventory — a typo, or a stale inventory.

unlinkedDiagrams.description: Diagrams whose reference carriers (name, title, header, footer, caption, notes) contain no requirement ID.

id.description: The requirement ID exactly as it appears in the inventory — the stable join key for any wider traceability matrix.

site.description: A diagram-side reference site: the diagram, and the line of the first carrier text containing the ID.

diagramType.description: An open set (new parsers add values) — consumers must tolerate unknown strings.
